item.description:
### English
- Yilo has a new electric-blue icon and a matching menu bar symbol. The Chinese versions use the 亦 artwork. - Learning records keep their paper-page layout. Jumping between distant entries in the index now lands more consistently. - Open and close the writing field with the round button in the lower-right corner. - The speaker animates while it reads a translation aloud. Traditional Chinese now uses 🇹🇼.
### 简体中文
- 《亦言》换上电光蓝图标和配套的菜单栏图案，简繁中文使用「亦」字图标。 - 学习记录保留纸页布局，从索引跳到相隔较远的记录时，落点更稳定。 - 点击右下角的圆形按钮即可展开或收起输入框。 - 朗读译文时，喇叭会显示声波动效。繁体中文使用 🇹🇼。

### English
- Ask follow-up questions in a panel on the right of the reading window. Narrow windows show it over the page. - See which record you are discussing with matching highlights in the index and on the page. Drafts stay available when you close or switch conversations. - Enjoy clearer input fields, with manual entry aligned to both page edges. Opening follow-up hides manual entry until you close it, preserving your draft. - The calendar icon, index heading, and record text now line up along the left edge.
### 简体中文
- 追问直接在阅读窗口右侧展开，小窗口下覆盖显示，边读边问更方便。 - 索引和正文同步高亮正在追问的记录，关闭或切换追问时保留未发送内容。 - 统一输入框样式，手动输入框与正文纸页两侧对齐；追问时自动隐藏，关闭后恢复原草稿。 - 调整日历图标、索引标题和记录文字的左侧对齐，界面更整齐。

## English
- Greatly reduced memory use and made scrolling smoother when a day contains many learning records. - Open long learning histories faster, with consistent page spacing and accurate index jumps.
## 简体中文
- 大幅降低记录较多时的内存占用，让连续阅读和滚动更流畅。 - 更快打开较长的学习记录，同时保持清晰的页面间隔和准确的索引跳转。

## English
- Read each record as its own page, with translations, learning notes, and examples together. - Find a record quickly in the original-text index. Smaller windows keep the index in a floating panel. - Enjoy clearer typography, more distinct pages, and comfortable spacing in light and dark appearances. - Keep your place while records refresh, and land more accurately when jumping from the index.
## 简体中文
- 每条记录像一页纸，译文、对应的学习笔记与例句放在一起，阅读更连贯。 - 左侧用原文快速索引，小窗口可打开浮动索引，给正文留出空间。 - 调整字号、行距与页面间隔，明暗外观下层次更清晰，阅读更舒适。 - 刷新记录时保留阅读位置，从索引跳转时定位更准确。

修复润色词条的英文正文字号未随设置调整的问题，让文字按所选大小显示。
Fixed English refinement text staying at its default size instead of following your text size setting.
